faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Lafayette?
faq.answer: Lafayette homeowners typically invest $8,000 to $18,000 for a full window replacement project. This upscale Contra Costa community features premium single-family homes in neighborhoods like Burton Valley, Happy Valley, and Upper Happy Valley. Projects covering 12–20 windows are typical. Single window installation starts at approximately $650.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Lafayette?
faq.answer: Yes. Lafayette requires building permits for window replacement through Contra Costa County Building Inspection. HOA requirements may also apply in some planned neighborhoods. Our team handles all county permit applications and HOA coordination on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Lafayette?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Lafayette commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Lafayette?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Lafayette replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Lafayette?
faq.answer: Most Lafayette projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
